panel-about.title: About the {{appName}} website.
panel-about.label: The {{appName}} site is a demo site. And has no commercial purposes.
panel-about.frontend_used: On the Frontend the following was used:
frontend_items: component for outputting an image file
service and component for displaying modal windows
Interceptor for updating the authorization token
Guard to control access to menu items
based on css-variables, 5 light and 5 dark color schemes have been prepared
the site is adapted for the old version of Chrome 109 (Windows 7, 8)
the site is adapted for the old version of FireFox 115 (Windows 7, 8)
